notes: Breadboard placement read from the circuit image: resistor spans columns 3 and 6 in the top half; LED legs in columns 6 (anode, bent leg, joined to resistor) and 8 (cathode, to GND); the pot straddles the centre gap with its wiper in column 23 (top half) and its outer pins in columns 22 and 24 (bottom half).
Row letters within each column-bank are arbitrary choices since all 5 holes in a column-bank are one strip; the image labels rows differently from the catalogue naming.
The 220 ohm resistor feeds the LED anode from pin 9; the LED cathode goes to GND, as in the text and schematic.
The black wire on the digital header uses GND.3 (next to AREF/pin 13); the power header GND is GND.1.
The pot's outer pins are interchangeable; GND went to column 22 and VCC (5V) to column 24 per the image.
